_note: Batch-2 (recalc_v2, migration 058) recipes: an INDB recipe rebuilt line by line by the 053 engine (indb.py / method.parts, pinned INDB commit), then the founder-approved edits below. Every edit is applied by scripts/recalc/batch2.py, which also SOLVES the oil lines from their stated rule, so no gram here is tuned by hand except the ones written as numbers (the soak water and the biryani water line, both documented); a water line can also be SOLVED down to an external anchor's measured water (dal makhani: the pot simmers down, so the line may only lose water). Moisture: 'target' + 'lab:<id>' = the 053 anchor rule (Wc = dry matter / (1 - lab water)), allowed only for an INDB recipe in an anchor-only cooking class; 'keep' = every listed gram stays (Wc = W), so a dish that must reach a measured moisture carries an explicit, documented K505 water line instead (the engine has no target moisture for STEADY recipes, by design: spec section (a)). External studies are anchors here (anchors.json), never rows of lab.csv, which feeds calibrate. Spec .claude/plans/v1.2-recalc-053-spec.md section (i); audit docs/testing/dish-row-audit-2026-11-13.md (adversarial review values).
